services.name: Rental Spaces
services.desc: Our adaptable mainstage theatre, the historic and ambient Anne Macdonald Studio, and other flexible spaces in between are all available to rent. For PHT Mainstage, Studio, and Weaving Room rentals, please contact Giselle at tech@phtheatre.org PLEASE NOTE: Our spaces tend to book up far in advance, so we are usually unable to accommodate last-minute requests.
